CustomField.description: Calculation of Mail Machine Support Comp based on plan sold.
CustomField.formula: IF( Total_Monthly_Services__c = 0,0, IF( Standard_MM_Support__c = TRUE, (Total_Hardware_Revenue__c * 0.10), IF( Silver_MM_Support__c = TRUE, (Total_Hardware_Revenue__c * 0.12), IF( Gold_MM_Support_Plan__c = TRUE, (Total_Hardware_Revenue__c * 0.14),0))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculation of Mail Machine Support Comp based on plan sold.
CustomField.label: MM Support Comp
